emails.subject: SSH Brute Force Investigation
emails.body:
Good morning,

Our monitoring systems have detected suspicious SSH authentication attempts on one of our production servers. At this stage we do not know whether the attacker successfully gained access. Please investigate the system and determine what happened.

Once your investigation is complete, submit your findings to me.

Good luck.

David Miller

emails.subject: Investigation Deliverables
emails.body:
Before closing this incident, please make sure your investigation includes the following:

• Identify the attacker's IP address.
• Determine whether the SSH login was successful.
• Collect any compromised or suspicious files.
• Submit the required evidence.
• Finally, send your terminal history together with your report.

Your terminal history is required before the investigation can be reviewed.
